description: React hook for managing OAuth flow with MCP, including token exchange, session storage, and redirect handling.

methods.name: useMcpOAuthFlow
methods.description: Custom React hook to initiate and resume MCP OAuth flow, managing state and session storage.

methods.name: buildCallbackUrl
methods.description: Constructs the OAuth callback URL based on current window location or server configuration.

methods.name: startOAuthFlow
methods.description: Begins the OAuth authorization process, handling registration, state generation, and redirect.

methods.name: resumeOAuthFlow
methods.description: Resumes OAuth process after redirect, exchanging code for token and handling errors.

methods.name: clearStoredFlow
methods.description: Removes OAuth session data from session storage.

methods.name: generateCodeVerifier
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure code verifier for PKCE.

methods.name: generateCodeChallenge
methods.description: Creates a code challenge from the verifier using SHA-256.
